items.title: Spring Boot skeleton, GET /health, and CORS
acceptance: backend/pom.xml exists and uses Java 17 + Spring Boot 3
GET http://localhost:8000/health returns 200
CORS allows http://localhost:5173
evidence: 2026-05-21: powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "./verify.ps1" -Target backend -Mode fast -> passed after verify.ps1 was updated to use backend/mvnw.cmd
2026-05-21: curl -i -H "Origin: http://localhost:5173" http://localhost:8000/health -> HTTP/1.1 200, Access-Control-Allow-Origin: http://localhost:5173, body contains status/service/timestamp

items.title: SSE emitter and heartbeat
acceptance: GET /api/plan/{planId}/stream returns text/event-stream
SSE stream sends heartbeat
SSE stream sends at least one mock state_change event

items.title: POST /api/plan returns planId
acceptance: POST /api/plan accepts text, scenario, and optional origin
Response uses camelCase planId and status
Invalid input returns the documented error shape

items.title: Agent state machine START to PACK
acceptance: State machine includes START, INTENT, SKELETON, RECALL, VALIDATE, REPLAN, PACK
Demo family input can reach PACK with a mock plan
Every state transition emits state_change
Candidate ranking documents and applies score = 0.4 relevance + 0.3 distance + 0.2 rating + 0.1 availability health

items.title: Plan B and DEGRADE rules
acceptance: restaurantFull scenario triggers replan
routeTooFar scenario triggers replan
After replan limit, state enters DEGRADE with readable reason
Normal non-injected Plan B rate can be measured separately from injected Plan B trigger accuracy

items.title: CLARIFY and ADJUST states
acceptance: Low confidence intent can enter CLARIFY
Clarify asks one question with 2-3 options and max 2 rounds
Adjust supports up to 3 local changes and emits adjust_result

items.title: POI mock data

Final POI JSON has at least 50 entries
Data covers family, friends, restaurant, dessert/cafe, and supplier categories
